mapper.sql: id, session_id, subject_type, subject_id, bound_at, visitor_token_hash, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_website_visitor_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_website_visitor_session ( id, session_id, subject_type, subject_id, bound_at, visitor_token_hash, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{id}::uuid, #{sessionId}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{boundAt}, #{visitorTokenHash}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, now()), COALESCE(#{updateTime}, now()) ) ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET update_time = now()
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_website_visitor_session SET subject_type = #{subjectType}, subject_id = #{subjectId}, bound_at = COALESCE(bound_at, now()), update_time = now() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}

UPDATE crm_website_visitor_session SET subject_type = 'Contact', subject_id = #{newContactId}, bound_at = COALESCE(bound_at, now()), update_time = now() WHERE subject_type = 'Lead' AND subject_id = #{oldLeadId}
